summary: The change introduces a 'coapplicant_tax_id' field into the baseline-mortgage applicant model but does not register it in NpiRegistry.FIELDS, meaning NpiVault will not encrypt it at rest. Because a tax identifier is explicitly NPI under ENC-1, and the modified file (ApplicantFields.java) is within ENC-1's scope, this is a direct violation of the encryption-at-rest obligation. The retention purge is handled (RET-1 shown), and all process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) are satisfied with adequate evidence. The LOG-1 obligation is open because the new NPI field is outside the masking registry and the packet does not contain enough evidence to confirm no existing log path would expose it. The change must be rejected until coapplicant_tax_id is added to the NPI registry so it is sealed at rest, and the logging risk is addressed.
